Amazon.fact: In January 2021, Amazon announced $500,000 for United Way organizations in Miami-Dade and Broward counties to support vulnerable families during the pandemic.

John S. and James L. Knight Foundation.fact: The Miami Foundation administers the Knight-supported Esserman-Knight Journalism Awards, recognizing investigative and public-service reporting in Miami-Dade, Broward and Monroe counties.
Knight awarded $3 million in November 2022 to establish the Miami-Dade Innovation Authority, supporting technology adoption in climate resilience, health and financial inclusion.

Frederick A. DeLuca Foundation.fact: Its Community Funding RFP prioritizes regranting in Miami-Dade, Broward and Palm Beach counties for economic mobility and youth-and-family programs.
It committed a $5 million matching grant to help launch and endow the Community Foundation of Broward’s Broward Center for Nonprofit Excellence.
It awarded Women In Distress of Broward County a $1.5 million matching grant for a capital campaign providing transitional housing for domestic violence survivors and their children.

McDermott Will & Schulte.fact: Legal Services of Greater Miami listed McDermott Will & Emery among its Leadership Circle financial donors in its April 2023 newsletter.

The Miami office received Legal Services of Greater Miami’s 2023 Equal Justice Pro Bono Large Firm Award for work including transactional clinics and full representation benefiting nonprofits, individuals and low-to-moderate-income small-business owners.

McDermott hired Jayme Cassidy as Miami-based transactions pro bono counsel in January 2025 to expand legal support for nonprofits, NGOs, small businesses and low-income entrepreneurs in underserved communities.
